scope: Stage2 connector retention only, not wiring or wire strain relief
cause_change: Use an underbody detachable fastener on existing flat rails, not ties over working levers or20 complex snap clips based on an unknown casing undercut
product_candidate: 3M Dual Lock low profile SJ4570 mating to itself; no substitution with standard Dual Lock

conflicting_source.rule: Regional product page differs from2024 datasheet. Do not merge revisions or declare a guaranteed thickness; verify delivered product and keep3mm project allowance

assembly: Use retained isolated PCB/carrier/side-rail assembly sequence; lower rail connectors before upper rail connectors
Verify actual underside offers adequate sound bonding surface, clean/dry PETG and casing using compatible manufacturer-directed preparation; never abrade or solvent-damage the connector
Centre two20x10mm pieces, one on rail and one on casing underside; no adhesive inside ports or onto operating parts; apply manufacturer-prescribed pressure and allow bond development
Engage pair while supporting rail; reject incomplete engagement, rocking or delivered thickness above3mm
Support casing by hand while operating levers; separate underbody fastener by a controlled tilt/lift rather than pulling wires
Temporary removal requires free wire slack and independent wire strain relief from later wiring stage; this design supplies neither
phase2_gates: Delivered exact tape revision/thickness and usable casing underside bonding area
PETG and connector substrate bond, peel/shear/creep at intended temperature, unpowered first
Actual lever/test-port operation and wire entry remain free; operator holds casing
Actual cable loads retained independently, no wire-pull load accepted from nominal adhesive area
No prototype use if bond/casing support fails; replace local retention without repeating baseline mounts
strength_claim: None. Manufacturer typical self-mating strength and static evaluation rule do not qualify adhesive bond to printed PETG, actual contact area, peel, dynamic wire loads or temperature
if_gate_fails: Local holder/retention redesign after measured casing fit; do not bypass unpowered bond test or energize
